collection.title: Mitsubishi Pajero Sport 1997 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mitsubishi Pajero Sport 1997 Onwards model requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this Pajero Sport , simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
